I was called by a person impersonating Navy Federal, using their caller id and their phone number. They said that someone tried to make a transfer under my card number in Florida and I said that was wrong, it wasn’t me. I was still under the assumption that I was still talking to navy federal not a scammer. They somehow were able to transfer $4,000 from my account to theirs using step.com when I never clicked the link or said yes. They proceeded to then FaceTime me saying it was a new way of helping users and they told me to move my money to another account to ensure that someone doesn’t try to hack my account again. The remaining $2,700 was then wire transferred to an account via Cash App. I still have the card number of the person and their zip code that they used when I transferred the money. Once I transferred the remaining amount they ended the call and didn’t pick up the phone after that.
Delivered a product that was not even remotely close to what was advertised.  I have attempted to get a refund 2 times and am getting no response.
